Container.Name: RaveBot
Container.Overview: Discord bot that automates DJ booking for recurring online raves: DJ onboarding by DM, self-service slot booking, automatic invites for open slots, day-before reminders, a lineup post in your DJ channel and an admin log. Events, slots, DJs and settings live in PostgreSQL; Notion is an optional mirror the bot keeps up to date, with hand edits in Notion checked and synced back. An optional admin page in the browser manages admins and DJs, downloads and restores backups, shows the Notion sync status and can rebuild the database from Notion. Needs a PostgreSQL 16 database and a Discord bot token; a Notion integration is optional. After the first start, run /setup in your Discord server.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL 16 database (for example the PostgreSQL 16 container from Community Applications).

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot, Reset Token).

Config.Name: PostgreSQL URL
Config.Description: Connection string of the database. Use the IP address of your Unraid server, not localhost.

Config.Name: Notion API key
Config.Description: Optional. Internal Integration Secret of your Notion integration. Set together with the parent page ID, or leave both empty.

Config.Name: Notion parent page ID
Config.Description: Optional. 32 character ID of an empty Notion page that is shared with the integration. The bot creates its databases under it.

Config.Name: Admin user IDs
Config.Description: Comma separated Discord user IDs of the owners. They can always use the admin commands.

Config.Name: Admin page password
Config.Description: Optional. Password of the admin page in the browser: admins, DJs, backup download and restore, Notion sync status, rebuild from Notion. Leave empty to turn the page off. Use a long random value.

Config.Name: Admin page port
Config.Description: Optional. Port of the admin page. Only used when a password is set. Local network only, never expose it to the internet.

Config.Name: Backup folder
Config.Description: Safety backups the bot saves before a restore, a rebuild or the one-time import from Notion (the newest 10 are kept). Keep this mapping so they survive an update of the container. The container makes the folder writable for its own user (ID 1000) at every start.

Config.Name: Backup folder inside the container
Config.Description: Optional. Where the bot writes its safety backups inside the container. Leave it at /data/backups so the Backup folder mapping above applies.
